name: iphone-ecommerce
description: Full-stack iPhone e-commerce & inventory management system (Sunset Glass).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
